items.title: Arthur Vigne Interview, 1961-11-29
items.q: They had a television program with Dave Garroway about three years ago.

ctx.x: Right. Those are the people I am speaking about. Same group. Yeah they were out in the park one time when Piku played. Yeah that's right. At Burry Guard Square. At Burry Guard Square. Yeah.
They had a television program with Dave Garroway about three years ago. And then Lizzie Miles and Paula Barberin's band and all of that. They had the group then. Now she dances that too Lizzie Miles.

Oh yes. She dances that chair. And they got a group right here. They dance that's a kid. They dance that's a kid walking or a quadrilles in the Fiesta. They got a 16th of... No they just had it. They had a dance right here at the Autocrats about two weeks ago. Oh yeah.
